title: Metadata, Tenant ACL and Provenance
local_environment_limits: Python 3.12 is not installed in the local classroom runtime.
The local Python 3.11 runtime does not contain the pinned mcp==2.2.0 integration dependency.
The managed sandbox does not allow the loopback listener used by the restart integration test.
The repository GitHub Actions workflow will run the complete suite with pinned dependencies on Python 3.12 after pull-request publication.
boundaries: A tenant match is not a content-read grant.
Source-declared metadata cannot create ACL, role, membership, grant or tenant authority.
A cached authorization decision is only a candidate and remains bound to current revisions, epoch, pointer and fence.
A signed permit is short lived, one-time and bound to subject, tenant, exact chunks, action, audience and purpose.
The PEP rereads current authority and provenance immediately before content release.
The in-memory classroom stores do not prove distributed atomicity, multi-process fencing or production durability.
